title: Page 10
content_zh:
段柯古轻抚她的唇，然后一低，再次吻住她。
她迷醉的呻吟，手穿过他黑发的瞬间，他同时将她抱起。
他抵着她唇瓣低语：“你知道我现在最想做什么？”
她怎不知道，凸挺的男物就这样梗在两人之间，要她装不懂也难，而她也不想装。
两人共度的一夜，是她用来抵抗相思与寂寞的灵药，她已不知在睡梦中回忆过多少次；而回忆，往往是不够的。
“我也想要。”她大胆说道。
他抽口气，然后低笑。“你总是出乎我意料，但我很喜欢。”
他将她搁在床上。
她仰望着他，双颊绯红地问：“你想过那一夜吗？”
“那已经不叫想过。”
他边说边解开她身上湿透的衣裳，取出她挂在脖子上的棉囊，她今回穿得比上回多，不过没关系，他们有的是时间。“而是渴望、还有害怕，我每天都在担心我会收到于伯的通知，说你……”
“不会了。”她按住他不让他往下说。“这种事再也不会发生。”
“你说的。”他略重地咬啮她指腹。“从今以后不管发生任何事，我都要你存着这个信念，一次一次，张开眼睛看着我。”
趟在他身下的她，是如此脆弱、美丽。
“我保证。”她微笑。
他脑子里再也没别的思绪，阔别已久的相思，需要最直接的抚触。
他可人的小娘子累坏了。
这是他美梦成真的一刻，云雨之后，他拉来薄被将两人轻轻盖住，然后以肘撑起身子，俯视贴在他臂弯熟睡的娇颜。
“就快了，这样的日子。”他爱怜地拂开她散落的垂发。晕睡的如意发出一声叹息，无意识地朝他怀中更偎了偎。
只要等她身子骨更健壮些，“小莲庄”上了轨道，他们就能像这样日夜守在一起，再也不分开。

望着怀中人儿，他在她额上，印上心满意足的吻。
五年后，江州府衙——
段柯古蹑手蹑脚潜进房里，伸手摇醒床上人。
“起床啦，嘘……别嚷嚷，小心把佣人吵醒了。”
“喔……”床上人儿揉揉惺忪的睡眼，眯着爱困的眼望着他爹。“时间到了吗？”
“差不多了，下来吧，我拿衣服让你穿上。”
眼前有张娃娃脸的小人儿姓段，名继东，今年四岁。几天前他爹同他说起他娘生辰已近，父子俩便筹划，要给他亲爱的娘一个大惊喜。
他们要合力做顿丰盛的早膳，让他娘觉得，他长大了，是个很厉害的大人了。
小继东下床，很配合地抬手伸脚，让他爹帮他穿衣穿鞋，“对了爹，娘的菜谱，您没忘了吧？”
“放心。”段柯古拍拍前胸，“砰砰”的闷响说明了答案。
时间真的过得很决，段柯古垂眸望着儿子结实的小身子，感觉他跟如意好像昨日才刚成了亲，怎么才一眨眼，就蹦出一个小家伙，还一下长这么大了！
他永远忘不了如意分娩那一晚，她脸色苍白，冷汗涔涔，他一瞬间还以为自己又将失去她，心头慌得不管产婆说什么，他就是不肯出去。
最后还是如意强忍着痛，说了几句话，劝退了他。
她说：“我答应过你的，无论如何，我一定会再醒来看着你。”
段柯古没告诉她，当产婆抱着全身红通通的小继东出来，他竟当着众人的面，难以自抑地掉下泪来。
遇上如意，是他另一个奇遇的开始。
以往他一直不了解，老天爷为何安排他——一个不喜名利权势的人，出生在权贵之家。但经过一连串的波折之后，他全都明白了。他多年来屈折自己云游四海的想望，或许，就是在等着遇上她，让他有那能力，适时保护他想要保护的人儿。
出了房门，段柯古交给儿子一盏红灯笼，然后牵起他手。“小心点走，别摔着了。”
“爹，你说我们待会儿要做什么？”
他歪头想了一下。“先熬粥吧，熬粥最费时间。再来要做的菜，昨儿个仆佣已经准备好了，等会儿我们就照你娘的子，一样一样做过去。”

晚些，如意在大约时间内起床准备到灶房做早膳，才刚跨出房门，就先看见一干仆佣围在花园边，交头接耳不知在笑什么。
“怎么了？”
“夫人早。”水盈福身唤道，然后指指灶房，要她自个儿看。
灶房里边，只见一高一矮两个人不断跑来跑去，一会儿是孩子囔着“水沸了水沸了，爹快点来”，紧接着响起的，就是段柯古的喊烫声。
如意一时会意不来。“他们到底在干什么？”
“帮夫人准备早膳啊！”水盈将昨晚大人交办的事全都说了。“大人跟少爷大概是想到平常都靠您早起备膳，想说今天您生辰，他们也做点什么不一样的事儿。”
望着灶房里她最爱的两个男人，又听水盈这么一说，如意感动得红了眼眶。
老天爷真是待她不薄，才能让她遇上这么一个温柔体贴的夫君，又生下一个聪明伶俐的孩子。
“不过里边情况，恐怕得找个人过去帮忙——”水盈又说。
“我来就行了。”如意擦擦眼，笑着赶开底下人。“你们都下去吧！”
“是。”
直到佣仆们一个个离开，如意深吐口气，悬上最甜美的笑容，走向灶房，她在木门上敲了两声。
只见屋里两人定在原地，然后慢慢转过身来，一大一小脸上，尽是尴尬。
“你起来啦！”
“娘早……”
直到走进灶房，她才知父子俩模样多狼狈，大的脸颊额上全沾这煤灰，小的呢，则是半身简淌着水，地上全是他不小心泼出来的水洼。
但说实话，她从没一刻感觉这么幸福过。
她看着他俩问：“有人需要帮忙吗？”
父子俩互瞧一眼，不约而同地开口：“……有。”
“瞧瞧你们两个。”她走过去拥住他们，先是帮大的擦干净脸，然后帮小的脱去身上湿衣，到角落拧干，再帮他穿上。

整顿好后，她朝他俩点了点头。“来吧，我们一起做。”
只见段柯古与儿子欢呼地拥住她，笑声，霎时盈满了整间灶房。
【全书完】
“北吃前门“一条龙”，南至河畔“小莲庄”，其中“一条龙”掌杓龙炎的故事，请看【天下一品】系列之一采花838《龙大当家》一书。
后记 艾珈
今年年后我收到了两份很大的礼物，大——说的不只是体积，还有更重要的，心意。
先来聊亲爱的芳。
芳写信给我一年有了喔。我记得去年，我回信时在里边提到我很喜欢裴勇俊，当时正迷他的“太王四神记”，我们两个在信里聊秀芝妮跟谈德聊得好愉快(完全是粉丝样)，然后再不久，我就收到出版社转寄来的纸箱。
里边摆着的，是芳送我的《太王四神记全纪录》。那天晚上，我一直处在炫耀状态，不但写信跟朋友说：“我的读者送我《太王四神记全纪录》耶！”也在我网络书柜上大叫，为什么里边没有十颗星啊？！
感动，不完全在礼物的价钱高低，而是想到芳特别买了这本书，然后寄来给我。
那个“特别为我”做的举动，我在信里告诉她说：“真恨不得以身相许！”（笑）
芳一直持续地写信、寄礼物来，收到她的信是很决乐的事——最重点是，芳的功课很好！（嘿嘿，爱读言小的读者成绩还是很赞的啦！）
另外一个，是读完《三戏憨夫》才提笔写信给我的趴趴熊。她的信有个很大的特色，有她自画的底图。那一天我在房间读信，我女儿走过来瞄见，突然惊呼了一声：“好漂亮，那是画的吗？”
content_en:
Duan Kegu gently touched her lips, then lowered his head and kissed her again.
She moaned intoxicatedly, and the moment her hands ran through his black hair, he picked her up at the same time.
He whispered against her lips: "Do you know what I want to do most right now?"
How could she not know that it would be difficult for her to pretend not to understand with the bulging male figure standing between the two of them, and she didn't want to pretend.
The night the two spent together was the elixir she used to resist lovesickness and loneliness. She had recalled it countless times in her sleep; and memories were often not enough.
"I want it too," she said boldly.
He gasped, then chuckled. "You always surprise me, but I love it."
He laid her down on the bed.
She looked up at him, her cheeks flushed and asked, "Have you ever thought about that night?"
"That's no longer something I've thought about."
As he spoke, he untied her soaked clothes and took out the cotton sac hanging around her neck. She wore more clothes this time than last time, but it didn't matter, they had plenty of time. "But it's desire and fear. I worry every day that I will receive a notice from Uncle Yu, saying that you..."
"No more." She held him down to prevent him from continuing. "This will never happen again."
"You said so." He bit her fingertips slightly. "No matter what happens from now on, I want you to keep this belief and open your eyes and look at me again and again."
She was so fragile and beautiful underneath him.
"I promise." She smiled.
There were no other thoughts in his mind. The long-awaited lovesickness needed the most direct touch.
His lovely little lady was exhausted.
This was the moment when his dream came true. After the clouds and rain, he pulled the thin quilt to gently cover the two of them, then propped himself up on his elbows and looked down at the beautiful face sleeping in his arms.
"It's going to be a day like this soon." He lovingly brushed away her loose hair. The sleepy Ruyi let out a sigh and unconsciously snuggled closer into his arms.
As long as she gets stronger and "Xiaolianzhuang" is on track, they can stay together day and night like this and never be separated again.
Looking at the person in his arms, he placed a satisfying kiss on her forehead.
Five years later, Jiangzhou government office——
Duan Kegu crept into the room and shook the person on the bed awake.
"Get up, shush... don't yell, be careful not to wake up the servant."
"Oh..." The man on the bed rubbed his sleepy eyes and looked at his father with sleepy eyes. "Is it time?"
"It's almost done. Come on down and I'll get some clothes for you to put on."
There is a baby-faced little man in front of him. His surname is Duan, his name is Jidong, and he is four years old this year. A few days ago, his father told him that his mother's birthday was approaching, and the father and son made plans to give his dear mother a big surprise.
They should work together to make a sumptuous breakfast to make his mother feel that he has grown up and is a very powerful adult.
Xiao Jidong got out of bed, raised his hands and feet cooperatively, and asked his father to help him get dressed and put on his shoes, "By the way, Dad, have you forgotten Mom's recipe?"
"Don't worry." Duan Kegu patted his chest, and the muffled "bang bang" sound explained the answer.
Time really flew by. Duan Kegu lowered his eyes and looked at his son's strong little body. He felt as if he and Ruyi had just gotten married yesterday. How could a little guy pop out in the blink of an eye and grow so big all of a sudden!
He would never forget the night when Ruyi gave birth. She was pale and sweating. For a moment, he thought he was going to lose her again. He was so panicked that no matter what the midwife said, he just refused to go out.
In the end, Ruyi endured the pain and said a few words to persuade him to retreat.
She said: "I promised you, no matter what, I will definitely wake up and look at you again."
Duan Kegu didn't tell her that when the midwife came out holding little Jidong who was all red, he could not help but shed tears in front of everyone.
Meeting Ruyi was the beginning of another adventure for him.
In the past, he never understood why God arranged for him - a man who didn't like fame, wealth and power.A powerful person is born into a powerful family. But after a series of twists and turns, he understood everything. He had been suppressing his desire to travel around the world for many years, perhaps because he was waiting to meet her, so that he would have the ability to protect the people he wanted to protect in a timely manner.
After leaving the room, Duan Kegu handed his son a red lantern and held his hand. "Go carefully, don't fall."
"Dad, what do you think we are going to do later?"
He tilted his head and thought for a moment. "Let's make the porridge first. It takes the most time to make porridge. Next, the servants have prepared the dishes yesterday. We will follow your mother's instructions and cook them later."
Later in the evening, Ruyi got up at a certain time and prepared to go to the kitchen to make breakfast. As soon as he stepped out of the door, he saw a group of servants gathered around the garden, whispering to each other and not knowing what they were laughing at.
"What's wrong?"
"Good morning, madam." Shui Yingfu called out, then pointed to the kitchen and asked her to see for herself.
Inside the kitchen, two people, one tall and one short, were seen running back and forth. For a while, the child muttered, "The water is boiling, the water is boiling, daddy, come quickly." The next thing that sounded was Duan Kegu's shouting.
Ruyi will not come for a while. "What are they doing?"
"Help Madam prepare breakfast!" Shui Ying said all the things assigned by the adults last night. "My lord and the young master probably thought that they usually rely on you to get up early to prepare meals, and they wanted to do something different for your birthday today."
Looking at the two men she loved most in the kitchen, and hearing what Shui Ying said, Ruyi was so moved that her eyes turned red.
God really treated her well, allowing her to meet such a gentle and considerate husband and give birth to a smart child.
"But the situation inside, I'm afraid I have to find someone to help -" Shui Ying added.
"I'll just come." Ruyi wiped her eyes and drove away the people below with a smile. "You all go down!"
"Yes."
Until the servants left one by one, Ruyi took a deep breath, put on the sweetest smile, walked to the kitchen, and knocked twice on the wooden door.
I saw the two people in the room frozen in place, and then slowly turned around, one face and one face full of embarrassment.
"You're up!"
"Morning mother..."
It wasn't until she walked into the kitchen that she realized how miserable the father and son looked. The elder's cheeks and forehead were covered in soot, while the younger's body was dripping with water. The ground was covered with puddles he accidentally splashed.
But to be honest, she had never felt so happy.
She looked at them and asked, "Does anyone need help?"
The father and son looked at each other and said in unison: "...Yes."
"Look at you two." She walked over and hugged them, first wiping the older one's face, then helping the younger one take off his wet clothes, wring them out in the corner, and then help him put them on.
After finishing, she nodded towards them. "Come on, let's do it together."
Duan Kegu and his son hugged her cheerily, and their laughter instantly filled the whole kitchen.
【Complete book】
"Yilong" at Qianmen in the north, and "Xiaolianzhuang" by the river in the south. For the story of "Yilong" holding Long Yan in his palm, please read the book "The Great Master of the Dragon" in Caihua 838, one of the "Tianxiapin" series.
Postscript Aijia
I received two very big gifts at the end of this year. The bigness refers not only to the size, but also, more importantly, to the heart.
Let’s talk about dear Fang first.
It’s been a year since Fang wrote to me. I remember last year, when I replied to the letter, I mentioned that I liked Bae Yong Joon very much, and I was obsessed with his "The Legend of the Four Gods" at the time. The two of us had a great time chatting about Soo Ji Ni and Dam Deok in the letter (we were totally fans), and not long after that, I received a carton forwarded by the publisher.
What is placed inside is "The Complete Records of the Four Gods of Taiwang" given to me by Fang. That night, I was always showing off. Not only did I write to my friend, "My reader gave me "The Complete Records of the Four Gods of the King"! "I also yelled on my online bookcase, why?There aren’t ten stars on the side? !
I was moved not entirely by the price of the gift, but by the thought that Fang specially bought this book and sent it to me.
That act she did "especially for me", I told her in the letter: "I really wish I could commit myself to you!" (laughing)
Fang has been writing letters and sending gifts all the time. It is a joy to receive her letters - the most important thing is that Fang's homework is very good! (Hey, the little reader who loves to read is still doing very well!)
The other one was Pa Pa Xiong who wrote to me only after reading "Three Plays of Foolish Husbands". One of the great features of her letters is that they have background drawings drawn by herself. That day I was reading a letter in my room. My daughter came over and took a look, and suddenly exclaimed: "It's so beautiful. Is that a painting?"
